Welcome to Threshold

A place beyond your room.

1. Choose a saved environment.
2. Adjust the time, or keep the preset.
3. Enter your portal.

The wall-mounted console previews a speculative shared physical simulation. Everyone remains physically isolated at home; the experience of presence is shared. No real teleportation, sensor mapping, invitations, or network connection occurs.

Use the people panel to send and accept simulated knocks. Inside, open Quick menu for lighting, ambience, notes, and privacy. Escape closes overlays or returns to the console.
